distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence, with records from Kaohsiung (Shanping) and Nantou (Hui Son and Neimoupu). No mainland-China occurrence is inferred.

host_note: The source characterizes the species as polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated host field; no host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea piceus (Motschulsky, 1863).
